text.formatted: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.
text.plain: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

text.formatted:
The naga is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks), and it needs only verbal components to cast its spells. It has the following wizard spells prepared:

- Cantrips (at will): Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Ray of Frost
- 1st level (4 slots): Charm Person, Detect Magic, Sleep
- 2nd level (3 slots): Detect Thoughts, Hold Person
- 3rd level (3 slots): Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing
- 4th level (3 slots): Blight, Dimension Door
- 5th level (2 slots): Dominate Person

text.formatted: _Melee Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
